annotations.description: Playing a basic Mountain instead of Rockface Village or Sunbillow Verge is slightly suboptimal. Rockface Village would allow casting either Hired Claw or Burnout Bashtronaut (via its creature-only red mana ability) while also providing utility later for pumping Lizards. Sunbillow Verge would establish a Plains for future white mana (for Seam Rip or High Noon draws). A basic Mountain provides only generic red mana with no upside. Since the player wants to cast a 1-drop creature this turn, Rockface Village is the best choice — it can tap for R to cast a creature, and its activated ability can later pump Hired Claw (a Lizard). Playing the basic Mountain now means Rockface Village played later won't have its R-for-creatures ability be as impactful since you'll already have Mountains for red mana.
